description: Every accepted edit on a hub document is durable collaboration state: it is relayed to live peers, advances the ledger head, reaches a late joiner's catch-up and survives a hub restart. Every agent lane is a visible principal: the human's roster lists it under its delegation label with the principal kind the hub authenticated (agent). Two agent lanes run the SAME gesture in fresh processes, so a replica identity collision (a replayed id acknowledged without a commit) turns the head row red.
